name: interactive-dpr-seamless
description: GPU-STARVE-3 guard: every interactive-DPR degrade/restore resize must repaint in the SAME task (no blank composite). Wraps gl.setSize; a queueMicrotask scheduled inside the wrapper runs before the browser composites, so `sameTask: frame advanced by then` is exactly 'fresh pixels were in the buffer at composite time'. Toggle cycles are forced deterministically: __resetInteractiveDegrade clears long-frame holds (this iGPU renders post-stack frames in seconds, pinning the degrade), cameraMotionSignal begin/end drives the edges, and a store nudge pumps demand-mode frames so the controller's rAF decision loop actually runs. Run with SHOT_GPU=1 and the sink: node -e 'require("http").createServer((q,s)=>{let b="";q.on("data",c=>b+=c);q.on("end",()=>{require("fs").appendFileSync("/tmp/dpr-probe.jsonl",b+"\n");s.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin","*");s.end("ok")})}).listen(8765)'

steps.name: install-probe
steps.eval: (() => { const gl = window.__three.gl; const P = window.__dprProbe = { resizes: [], losses: 0 }; gl.domElement.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', () => { P.losses++ }); const orig = gl.setSize.bind(gl); gl.setSize = (w, h, updateStyle) => { const before = gl.info.render.frame; const r = orig(w, h, updateStyle); const rec = { t: Math.round(performance.now()), w: Math.round(w * gl.getPixelRatio()), frameBefore: before, frameAtMicrotask: -1, sameTask: false }; rec.stack = (new Error().stack||'').split('\n').slice(1,20).map(l=>l.trim()); P.resizes.push(rec); queueMicrotask(() => { rec.frameAtMicrotask = gl.info.render.frame; rec.sameTask = rec.frameAtMicrotask > before }); return r } })()

steps.name: post-summary
steps.eval: fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8765/', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(Object.assign({ dpr: window.__three.gl.getPixelRatio(), buf: window.__three.gl.drawingBufferWidth }, window.__dprProbe)) })
